calculate_view_metrics: calculate RGB, depth, mask, and eikonal metrics from raymarched renderer output and ground truth tensors
calculate_regularization_metrics: calculate autodecoder norm regularization penalty from a model with a sequence_autodecoder attribute
compute_rgb_metrics: compute huber loss, MSE, L1, and PSNR metrics between predicted and ground truth RGB images
compute_eikonal_loss: compute the eikonal regularizer loss from a gradient of a signed distance function tensor
compute_density_tv_loss: compute the total variation regularizer loss from a 3D density grid tensor
